One quick question for you

Hi again,

Just one question today, and it only takes a minute.

What would help you most from PescoDial?

PescoDial is brand new. We haven't filled the shelves yet, and I'd rather build around what you actually need than guess. So I'm asking the people who use the calculator first.

Here are a few things people often want when they start eating more fish. Pick one, pick three, or tell me something that isn't on the list:

  • Simple recipes with five or six ingredients
  • A printable food list you can stick on the fridge or take to the store
  • Help understanding cholesterol or blood pressure numbers so you can talk them over with your doctor
  • Eating well on a tight budget
  • Cooking for one or two without wasting food
  • Which fish to buy, and how to cook it without the kitchen smelling for days
  • Making the plan work with a partner or family who isn't on board yet
  • Something else entirely

Just hit reply and tell me. One line is plenty. "Recipes for one" is a perfectly good answer. If you'd like to tell me a bit about your situation, like what you're hoping to change or what's made it hard before, I'd love to hear it. That helps me write things that fit real lives, not imaginary ones.

A real person reads every reply. That's me. I can't give medical advice by email, and I won't try, but your answers go straight into deciding what we write and make next.

While you think about it, your numbers are always here if you want another look: https://www.pescodial.com/calculator/
